params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $wt="$env:USERPROFILE\mhw-mods-pr90-integration"; if(!(Test-Path $wt)){throw 'PR90_WORKTREE_MISSING'}; Set-Location $wt; 'HEAD='+(git rev-parse HEAD); 'BRANCH='+(git branch --show-current); 'STATUS_BEGIN'; git status --short --branch; 'STATUS_END'; 'LOG_BEGIN'; git log -5 --format='%H|%P|%s'; 'LOG_END'; 'MERGE_HEAD='+(git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD 2>$null); 'REVISION_TOP_BEGIN'; Get-Content '_AGENT_CONTEXT\CURRENT_REVISION.json' -TotalCount 22; 'REVISION_TOP_END'; 'CONFLICTS_BEGIN'; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U; 'CONFLICTS_END'
